_comment: TDD M4 slice: per-route dialect override. Current Go build rejects explicit different dialect at --validate-config (milestone 4+); HTTP expectations below describe the contracted egress (provider-owned auth, dest-keyed URL/headers/classification). count_tokens is NOT set on the chat provider (config rejects it there).
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chat]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "prov-chat-secret"

[[models]]
name = "rd-count"
provider = "chat"
model = "claude-haiku-4-5"
dialect = "anthropic"
name: m4_route_dialect_count_tokens_to_anthropic_refused
